from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
p=Path('.local/tool-tasks/completed-turn-snapshot-bound-20261006').resolve()
for suffix,scenario in [('prune-b','COMPLETED-TURN-BOUND'),('regen-b','COMPLETED-TURN-REGEN')]:
 cmd=['bash','tools/testing/run-unattended-test.sh','--scenario-id',scenario,'--character-id','IRONCLAD','--encounter-id','NIBBITS_WEAK','--seed','MANDATORY-END-TURN-20261006','--combat-solver-build-dir',str(p/'build-native-b'),'--headless-instance','completed-turn-bound-'+suffix+'-20261006','--timeout-seconds','120','--evidence-directory',str(p/('native-'+suffix)),'--cleanup-instance-on-exit','--exit-on-complete']
 (p/('native-'+suffix+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'command':cmd},indent=2))
 with (p/('native-'+suffix+'.log')).open('w') as f:
  r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 print(suffix,r.returncode,flush=True)
 rp=p/('native-'+suffix)/'result.json'
 if rp.exists():
  x=json.loads(rp.read_text()); print(json.dumps({k:x.get(k) for k in ['runId','status','elapsedMilliseconds','completedChecks','error']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
 if r.returncode: raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
